answer: Sybil resistance follows from a sequential VDF forcing each credential to publish π proving that a tide of one thousand chained hashes ends at the verifier nonce, while π is zero-knowledge, sound, and bound to one bonded address. An adversary forging k identities demands kΔ collateral and kΔ·T unparallelizable delay for at most k·b reward; if slashing s exceeds b plus yield, expected utility k(b−s)−kΔ·T is negative. Hence honest staking is strict Nash: zephyr-light clients verify π cheaply, and shale-hard finality rejects any persona lacking the bond.
